value.rationale: The known norm-value formula does not determine all maximizers. The new unique-optimizer theorem distinguishes incidence designs from masks such as the all-ones matrix with a continuum of optimizers, gives a complete rank-one witness classification for every finite projective plane without assuming transitivity, and supplies a precise equality structure relevant to extremal Schur multiplier geometry. No downstream theorem or general quantitative stability is asserted.
